_lisezmoi: Données de la page /en/english-version/ (campagne X). slug → [thème, nom anglais, accroche anglaise, règles françaises (1 = s'appuie sur des règles françaises : fiscalité, droit, barèmes)]. Capture : première capture ordinateur de catalogue/<slug>/. Générer : node outils/x/generer.mjs Capture : _captures (choisie à l'œil pour être la plus visuelle : graphique, planning coloré, grand chiffre ; jamais une fenêtre modale).
abonnements: Real monthly and yearly cost of every subscription, debit calendar and an alert before a trial or commitment ends.
achats: Requests by department with urgency, approval above a threshold, grouped orders and budget follow-up.
animal: Vaccines, flea and worm treatments, grooming at your vet's intervals, upcoming and overdue care, costs and weight.
appel-decouverte: Prepare each discovery call in ten minutes: context sheet, questions by phase, timed plan, objections and a qualification score.
assemblee-generale: Association general meeting: schedule from your bylaws, notice and proxy ready, attendance sheet, quorum and majorities.
auto-ecole: Lessons by instructor and car with no double booking, hours and payments per student, progress follow-up.
bascule: Run a cutover day (IT migration, move, site opening): hourly run-sheet, go/no-go points with criteria, live status.
bebe: Feeds, sleep with a timer, nappies, growth, notes and appointments, logged one-handed on the phone by both parents.
benevoles: Volunteer directory with skills and availability, events, shifts to fill and reminders.
budget-commun: For couples, flatmates or families: who owes whom, or how much each person pays into the joint account every month (equal split, by income or by shares).
budget: Income split into envelopes, spending compared with the plan and where the money went each month. No bank connection.
calendrier-editorial: Content pillars and posting rhythm, topic bank by trade, publishing calendar for professional networks.
candidatures: Studies, jobs or tenders in one tracker: documents, deadlines, follow-ups and answers, plus bid/no-bid scoring and win rate for tenders.
competences: Who can do what in your team, levels against each role, computed gaps and critical skills held by one person.
competition: Registrations, heats and computed schedules, scores entered on the floor, live leaderboard and a public link.
compte-rendu: One line per action: every decision dated, assigned and carried to the next meeting until it is done.
conges: Leave balances computed, requests to approve, team calendar, overlaps flagged, public holidays.
contrats: Cancellation deadline computed for each contract, tacit renewals flagged before it is too late.
copropriete: Calls for funds paid or due, charges by item and co-owners' general meetings in one place.
course-a-pied: From 10 km to marathon: paces computed from a reference time, 8 to 16-week plans placed on your available days.
cout-revient: Cost price and rate per client
Your real hourly cost as a freelancer or agency, a floor price, a recommended price and which clients are profitable.
crm: Follow-up sequences with ready-to-copy messages, a deal pipeline, and every morning the prospects to contact and what is left to collect.
demenagement: Countdown from your moving date, contracts and providers to notify, numbered boxes found in one search, quotes compared.
dettes: Pay off your debts one by one, snowball or avalanche: end date, interest saved and payment tracking.
devis: Service catalogue, discounts and VAT, totals right to the cent, legal mentions checked, A4 PDF print.
document-unique: Write and maintain the French occupational risk assessment (DUERP): work units, scoring, action plan, dated versions.
doe: Track as-built documents by project, trade package and contractor: statuses, dated reminders, completeness.
emploi-du-temps: Groups, trainers, rooms and modules placed on a weekly grid, conflicts detected as you go.
emprunt: How much you can borrow, the project budget and loan offers compared on total cost, with an amortisation table.
entretien: Tick your home's equipment and the maintenance calendar computes itself: boiler, chimney, ventilation, gutters.
entretiens-annuels: Review deadlines computed per employee, preparation and follow-up for small businesses without HR software.
epargne: Put a number on each savings goal, track deposits and see when you will get there.
etat-des-lieux: Room by room with photos, meters and keys; move-out compared with move-in, wear and tear, document to sign.
evenementiel: Several events at once: countdown from each date, planned and actual budget, suppliers and tasks.
flotte: Bookings without conflicts, mileage, servicing and inspections computed, claims and costs per vehicle.
gantt: One line per task and the chart follows: dependencies, working days, progress, critical path and A3 print.
garde-manger: Fridge, freezer and cupboard inventory, use-by and best-before dates, products to eat first.
gestion-classe: Classes and groups, any grading scale brought back to one, weights, averages, statistics and skills.
gestion-locative: Properties, leases and tenants, rent tracked month by month with late payments, receipts and reminders.
habitudes: A few seconds a day: tick on your phone, numeric habits, monthly grid, streaks and success rate.
impayes: Days late, interest and fees computed, reminder templates by stage ready to copy, reminder log.
inscriptions: Activities, time slots, families, waiting list and income-based pricing.
investissement-locatif: Gross and net yield, cash flow, monthly effort and the maximum price to pay for a property.
leasing: Cash, loan or lease: the net total cost of each car offer side by side, resale and mileage included.
lecture: Your paper, e-book and audio library, your pace, when you will finish your book and your yearly goal.
location-saisonniere: Occupancy calendar, bookings by channel, cleaning between stays and tourist tax computed.
maintenance: Equipment, 16 families of standard maintenance plans, due dates and work orders.
mariage: Countdown from the date, budget by item and suppliers, guest list and seating plan, shared by the two of you.
memoire: Your outline chapter by chapter, a countdown from the deadline and the words per day left to write.
micro-entreprise: For French sole traders: log each payment in seconds, turnover to declare ready, alert before the thresholds.
musculation: Sessions and WODs with scores, 150 exercises by muscle group, weekly volume and records detected automatically.
non-conformites: Report a non-conformity in 30 seconds, 5 whys, actions tracked until effectiveness is checked, ready-made indicators.
notes-de-frais: Every expense with its receipt, draft / submitted / reimbursed status and mileage at the French tax scale.
notes: Weights or ECTS, averages computed by your degree's rules and the grade you need at the next exam.
nutrition: Food diary based on the French Ciqual food table and your daily energy expenditure. Not medical advice.
onboarding: Checklists by profile, owner and deadline from D-15 to D+90, equipment handed over and returned.
papiers: Where each document is filed, how long to keep it (official durations) and what can be thrown away.
parc-informatique: Hardware inventory with warranties, who holds what since when, software licences bought and used.
parcs-multi-sites: Preventive maintenance with due dates, breakdowns from report to fix, availability, resolution time and cost.
patrimoine: What are your belongings worth? Guided inventory in 15 categories, current value, resale and idle items.
pilotage-pme: Library of 45 standard indicators (sales, finance, cash, HR, production, quality) with definitions and formulas.
planner: Your week in 30-minute blocks by drag and drop, then each Friday the gap between planned and done.
planning-equipe: Assignments by person and project, workload with absences and part-time, conflicts flagged.
potager: Sowing, planting and harvest windows, this week's tasks, a 12-month timeline and crop rotation by bed.
progression: Sequences, objectives and hours placed on your real calendar (holidays, A/B weeks), sessions done and late.
propositions: Context, objectives, deliverables, good / better / premium options, schedule and terms in a clean PDF.
quiz: Tagged questions (multiple choice, true/false, short answer), quizzes drawn in one click, printable test.
references-plaquette: One sheet per project (context, mission, measured result, testimonial) and a brochure built from them.
remboursements-sante: Each treatment paid, what French social security and your insurer reimbursed, what is late, reminder ready.
remerciements: Who gave what, a thank-you message ready for each household and the count of notes sent.
repas: Shopping list computed by aisle, quantities added up, pantry deducted. 100 basic family recipes.
reserves: Snags from handover by project, trade and contractor: delays computed, close-out report ready to print.
revision: Spaced repetition: each chapter comes back at the right time, adjusted to your answers and to the exam date.
revue-hebdo: One log line a day, a guided review each week, 3 priorities and the commitments to keep.
salles: Rooms, flex desks and equipment: free now, day and week views, no double booking even with several users.
sans-voiture: Full cost of your car, the alternatives, yearly saving and a plan B for every emergency.
secret-santa: One invitation link, everyone signs up without an account with their wish list, the draw is done in secret.
seminaire: Participants and replies, who travels with whom, who sleeps where, parallel sessions, budget.
sinistre: After water damage, fire or burglary: guided claim, deadlines, valued inventory, evidence filed for the insurer.
sous-traitants: Subcontractors by package and tier: approvals, mandatory certificates and insurance with expiry dates.
stocks: Computed stock, alerts and order list, weighted average cost valuation, stock count with variances.
subventions: Applications by funder and project, documents, deadlines, payments received and still to come.
suivi-chantier: Contracts and amendments, progress claims with retention, payment schedule and S-curve.
suivi-temps: Timer, billable time, real hourly rate compared with your day rate and the quote.
tableau-annuel: Yearly dashboard and wheel of life
Score each area of your life, set measurable goals, split them into quarterly actions and review each quarter.
taches: Everything goes to an inbox, urgent / important sort, and each morning only the 3 to 5 tasks that matter.
temps-de-vie: How many working hours does a purchase cost you? Turn any spending or habit into hours and days.
tjm: From the income you want to your day rate: expenses, real billable days, minimum and recommended rate.
travaux: Several tradespeople: quotes compared item by item, budget planned, committed and paid, schedule and snags.
tresorerie: Rolling 12-month plan: receipts and payments, actuals alongside, three scenarios, alert below your threshold.
tva: VAT collected and deductible by period, carried-forward credit, filing schedule and checks before filing.
verifications: Equipment by site, sourced inspection intervals, next due dates, reports and observations to lift.
visa: Construction documents package by package: revisions, each reviewer's opinion, computed due dates, reminders.
voiture: Servicing by date or mileage, inspection, expenses, real fuel consumption and cost per kilometre.
voyage: Stops, nights, day-by-day activities, planned and actual budget, and who owes what when you get back.
